name: Şehzade Bayezid
contribution: An Ottoman prince and the son of Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent and Hürrem Sultan.

checks.lead: Şehzade Bayezid (Ottoman Turkish: شهزاده بايزيد‎; 1527 – 25 September 1561) was an Ottoman prince and the son of Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent and Hürrem Sultan.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
